_comment: Example golden set. Copy it to eval/golden.json (ignored by git) and write queries for your own corpus. An expectation references content (document name + breadcrumb or text substring), never chunk IDs. One matching expectation makes a hit. A query with no_answer=true has no expectation; the run records its top 1.

queries.query: Wie installiere ich die Software unter Linux?
queries.note: Breadcrumb anchor: the answer is the full section.

queries.query: Welcher Port ist der Standardport für verschlüsselte Verbindungen?
queries.note: Two correct sources. Inside one expectation all set conditions must match.
